semantics.sovereign: Each character, digit, zero, one, person, project, source, asset and relationship retains its own identity and compartment.
semantics.addition: Joining two independent boxes preserves the two entities. Their relationship is an additional record, not identity merger.
semantics.subtraction: Revoking a previously granted relationship removes permission from future uses; external backups/records need separately authorized deletion.
semantics.numbers: Preserve full numeric meaning in math AND display each written digit in its own visual box. Ten is [1][0], not an identity merged into one digit.
semantics.absence: Zero is a distinct represented box; do not erase original history when revoking access.

disclosure: Source ZIPs, private source contents, unreviewed media, identities, personal data and confidential app descriptions are not published. Public names come from the owner's original game index and existing public app registry. Proposed idea slots expose IDs only.
